# Tokens

Values live in `tokens.css`; this file explains them.

## Accounting

| Measure | Count |
|---|---|
| Source tokens | 4 |
| Tokens with aliases | 1 |
| Mode values | 8 |
| Resolved mode values | 8 |
| Unresolved / circular / invalid mode values | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| CSS variables emitted from source tokens | 4 |
| Source tokens not emitted | 0 |
| Ambiguous shared color values | 1 |

Counts differ by definition: a source token can contain several mode values, and unresolved or unsupported tokens are not emitted as CSS variables.
